profile_text.body:
Microsoft is a public company founded in 1975 and headquartered in Redmond, Washington. Its Power Automate page describes the product as automating workflows and business processes across apps, systems, and websites using AI, digital, and robotic process automation. The page includes a customer statement that a data validation process that used to take over 100 people can be managed by just a few people with generative AI and Power Automate.

The company's AI products include Microsoft Power Automate AI, Microsoft Copilot, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI Service, AutoGen, Microsoft Designer, Microsoft Teams AI, SharePoint AI, Microsoft Clipchamp AI, Semantic Kernel, and Microsoft Agent Framework. Microsoft Copilot is described as embedded across M365, and Azure OpenAI Service provides OpenAI models in Azure regions with enterprise content filtering and data residency controls.

SEC records list Microsoft under CIK 0000789019 with ticker MSFT. Its 10-K for the period ended June 30, 2026 reports revenue of $331,839,000,000. Microsoft appears in two cases in U.S. District Court, S.D. New York: The New York Times Co. v. Microsoft Corp. and OpenAI, and Authors Guild v. OpenAI, Inc. Washington state law exposure entries total 114 for Microsoft.
